name: Battle Suit Aces
description:
About This Game

The Battle Suit Aces campaign is a fully-voiced, sci-fi epic that feels like a Saturday morning cartoon with you at the helm. Recruit your pilots, upgrade their battle suits, and command them to victory!

STORY

When a new threat to the galaxy emerges, Union Command dispatches a ragtag team of pilots and scientists to investigate. Join Captain Heathcliff and his Patchworks crew as they search for powerful Relic Suits in a tale of friendship and belonging.

BATTLE

Deploy a wide array of upgradable mecha pilots in card combat. Pair them with energy-generating Drones and potent Command Cards.

CREW

Recruit and bond with 25 pilots from five powerful factions. Each faction has their own unlockable missions and combat strategies.

FEATURES

  • Experience the Patchworks crew’s journey across 45 thrilling episodes.

  • All 75 characters are fully-voiced by the incredible cast.

  • Over 40 tracks composed by Carlos "insaneintherain" Eiene.

  • Lane-based attack patterns and unique card passives form an accessible, deep combat system.

  • Prepare for story-driven battles, including surprise attacks, heists, and Starball matches.

  • Dozens of mods let you customize your ship and cards to build the perfect deck.

Suit Up!
short_desc: Battle Suit Aces is a tactical deckbuilder that can be played as a clever roguelite or epic campaign full of tender moments, cosmic quests, and charming characters.
